mapper.select: SELECT id FROM audit_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_at <= now() ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{maxRows}
SELECT id, event_id, payload, trace_id, status, attempts, next_retry_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at, version FROM audit_outbox WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_outbox SET status = 'SENT', updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE audit_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'FAILED' END, attempts = attempts + 1, next_retry_at = now() + (interval '1 minute' * CASE least(attempts, 3) WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END), last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
